basic_details.job_title: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3047 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) has released the ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification for 3,047 apprenticeship seats across various trades and disciplines. Eligible candidates with Class 10, Class 12, ITI, Diploma or Graduation qualifications, depending on the trade, can apply online through the NAPS or NATS apprenticeship portals.

age_limit.details: The age limit for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 18 to 24 years as on 29 November 2026. Candidates' dates of birth should fall between 29 November 2002 and 29 November 2008, subject to applicable relaxation.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their online applications before the closing date. ONGC has also announced the scheduled date for the selection result. ONGC may extend the application deadline if insufficient applications are received or suitable candidates are unavailable. Applicants should check the official website for any revised dates.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: ONGC has advertised 3,047 tentative apprenticeship vacancies across six sectors. The Western Sector has the highest allocation, followed by the Eastern and Mumbai Sectors. Apprenticeship seats are distributed across ONGC's operational locations. Candidates must meet the domicile or qualification-location conditions specified in Annexure I for their chosen work centre.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the educational qualification prescribed for their chosen apprenticeship trade. The available disciplines cover ITI trades, commerce, science, business administration, engineering and other qualifications. Additionally, candidates who have already undergone or are undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act are not eligible. Applicants must not have completed three years after passing the qualifying examination as on 29 November 2026. Candidates with one year or more of training or work experience after the prescribed qualification are not eligible for Technician Apprenticeship.

rows.required_qualification: ITI in the relevant prescribed trade
12th Class or two-year ITI after Class 10
Degree in the relevant Engineering discipline
Three-Year Diploma in the relevant Engineering discipline
Graduation with Geology as one of the subjects

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 18 to 24 years as on 29 November 2026 . Candidates' dates of birth should fall between 29 November 2002 and 29 November 2008, subject to applicable relaxation.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The official ONGC Apprentice notification does not specify an application fee. Candidates must apply through the respective government apprenticeship portal and follow the instructions displayed there.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300 , depending on their educational qualification and apprenticeship category. The apprenticeship training period is 12 months for all trades. ONGC will not provide transportation, boarding or lodging expenses. Apprenticeship engagement does not guarantee regular employment with ONGC.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on the marks obtained in the prescribed qualifying examination. A provisional merit list will be prepared separately for the relevant trades, disciplines and work centres. Application Scrutiny: Verification of eligibility, academic qualifications, age and other requirements. Provisional Merit List: Prepared based on marks in the qualifying examination. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates and required supporting documents. Final Merit List: Prepared after eligibility and document verification, considering applicable reservation provisions. Engagement Formalities: Selected candidates must complete the required registration, document and medical fitness formalities. If two candidates have equal merit marks, the older candidate will receive preference. The notification does not prescribe a separate written recruitment examination.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Work Centre Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates are eligible for a particular ONGC work centre only if they are residents of an eligible district or have obtained their prescribed educational qualification from an eligible district. For example, the Chennai work centre covers all districts of Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, while the Hazira work centre specifies Surat, Navsari, Tapi, Dang and Valsad districts. Other locations have their own eligibility conditions. Applicants should consult Annexure I of the official notification before choosing a work centre. A candidate should apply for one trade at one work centre, as directed in the application instructions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply online through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) or National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal, depending on their chosen trade. Offline applications are not accepted. Important: Applications submitted by post, by hand or through any other offline mode will not be accepted. Ensure that the correct apprenticeship scheme and eligible work centre are selected.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: The online application process is open from 29 October to 20 November 2026. Eligible candidates should apply through the appropriate portal: NAPS Apprentices: Apply through NAPS Portal NATS Apprentices: Apply through NATS Portal Candidates can check recruitment updates, selection lists and other notifications through the official ONGC apprenticeship website.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in ONGC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ONGC has advertised 3047 Apprentice vacancies under Advertisement No. ONGC/APPR/1/2026. The notification's sector-wise subtotals contain a discrepancy, so candidates should check for any official clarification.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply online for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official NAPS portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in or the NATS portal at nats.education.gov.in, depending on the selected apprentice trade.

faq.question: Q4. What is the ONGC Apprentice salary per month in 2026?
faq.answer: The ONGC Apprentice monthly stipend ranges from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300, depending on the apprentice category and qualification.

faq.question: Q5. Can ITI candidates apply for ONGC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. ITI-qualified candidates can apply for eligible apprenticeship trades such as Electrician, Fitter, COPA, Welder, Mechanic Diesel, and other notified trades, subject to the required qualification and work-centre eligibility.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 24 years as on 29 November 2026. Upper age relaxation is applicable for eligible reserved categories according to the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available under ONGC Recruitment 2026 Tripura?
faq.answer: The ONGC Agartala work centre in Tripura has 200 Apprentice vacancies for various trades and disciplines.

faq.question: Q8. How many ONGC Apprentice vacancies are available in Assam?
faq.answer: The notification lists 674 vacancies across Jorhat, Nazira and Sivasagar, and Silchar work centres in Assam.

faq.question: Q9. Can Odisha candidates apply for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates from eligible districts of Odisha may apply for the Kolkata work-centre opportunities, subject to the prescribed qualification and location eligibility conditions. No separate Odisha work centre is listed.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a written examination for ONGC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No separate written examination is prescribed in the notification. Selection is based on qualifying examination marks, eligibility verification, and document verification.
